name: Level Length
description: Shows the exact playtime length of a level next to its size category (Tiny/Short/Medium/etc).

timer-x-axis-offset.name: Timer - X Axis Offset
timer-x-axis-offset.description: Moves the timer left (negative numbers) or right (positive numbers)

timer-y-axis-offset.name: Timer - Y Axis Offset
timer-y-axis-offset.description: Moves the timer down (negative numbers) or up (positive numbers)

show-object-count.name: Show Object Count
show-object-count.description: Shows the level's total object count directly above the length text (Tiny/Short/Medium/etc).

object-count-x-axis-offset.name: Object Count - X Axis Offset
object-count-x-axis-offset.description: Moves the object count left (negative numbers) or right (positive numbers)

object-count-y-axis-offset.name: Object Count - Y Axis Offset
object-count-y-axis-offset.description: Moves the object count down (negative numbers) or up (positive numbers)

show-hide-timer-checkbox.name: Show Hide-Timer Checkbox
show-hide-timer-checkbox.description: Shows a small checkbox below the timer to hide/show it for that specific level (useful for Time Warp/Teleport levels with inaccurate times). Turn this off to remove the checkbox entirely.

checkbox-x-axis-offset.name: Checkbox - X Axis Offset
checkbox-x-axis-offset.description: Moves the hide-timer checkbox left (negative numbers) or right (positive numbers)

checkbox-y-axis-offset.name: Checkbox - Y Axis Offset
checkbox-y-axis-offset.description: Moves the hide-timer checkbox down (negative numbers) or up (positive numbers)
